name: Cuspirostrisornis
sum: Small perching enantiornithean from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, possibly the same as Cathayornis.
holotype: IVPP V 10897, collected in 1993; skull about 27 mm long.
biology: Had a toothed snout; the beak Hou presumed is probably a misinterpretation.
author: Hou 1997
